one_liner: Open-source and Adobe ecommerce platform with REST, SOAP and GraphQL web APIs.
access_notes: Merchant creates an integration in admin to get tokens (OAuth 1.0a/token); SaaS edition uses Adobe IMS OAuth in Developer Console.
mcp_note: Third-party servers e.g. github.com/magenable/magento-adobe-commerce-mcp-server; Adobe MCPs target developer tooling
blocker_note: Per-store self-hosted instances; auth differs between PaaS (token/OAuth1a) and SaaS (Adobe IMS).
